title: pm-dispatch: the L2 seat is the fallback for lanes that cannot reach the contract-review tier
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XV2aL7WR7UrUpqiMry8dj9)_

Fixes #34376

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:L2 复审席改为兜底——只接点名它的交接行或信箱敲门、它自己记录的 delta、以及其他席都被禁的 head;等满一轮 (b)、车道离席 (c)、等 L2 标记一律归车道(达档自审,或写交接行);欠审表 `check-owed-reviews.mjs` 的接手人同步改。
- 为什么改:卡正文引维护者原话「L2 级别的审核 用 Fable，有的席位可能fable不够，才需要开单独的 review 席位」;review#1 本班 18 条记录里只有 3 条是真兜底,其余是车道本可自审的超时 head。
- 风险与回滚:只动 pm 规则文本与一个只报告、不拦截的脚本,无产品面、无发布;回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`references/contract-review.md` 第 24–26 行;`scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` 的 `takerOf`;`SKILL.md` 〈审核两级〉第 50 行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test`,预期 97 例全过、10 个电池。
- 需要你做的:无,Tier S,review#1 达档 PASS 后席位落地。

## What changes

The L2 seat becomes the fallback, never the default taker of an owed head (the maintainer's direction, quoted verbatim in the card body).

1. `references/contract-review.md` 〈L2 归属与资格〉, lines 24–26 reworded in place (63 → 63 lines): an owed head with no record and no live claim is the lane's under (a)(b)(c), which reviews at the tier or hands off; (a) now names the `Request: contract-review` knock beside the hand-off line; the L2 seat takes only an (a) that names it, the delta of its own record, and a head every other seat is barred from. Line 11 loses the clause 「由车道席位作 L2 记录」, now said once in SKILL.md (item 4).
2. `references/lanes/l2-review.md` 路由, line 15 replaced by a pointer to contract-review.md (no restatement); line 8 loses 「仅申报面 `TIER_DEFAULT`,档随面定照 contract-review.md」, which told the L2 seat it reviews the `TIER_DEFAULT` face (22 → 22 lines).
3. `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` `takerOf`: a TAKE row names the seat a hand-off names; else a seated, unbarred L2 seat on the delta of a record it signed (the record's signature line, new `signerSeatOf`); else the lane seat (its next seat on duty under (c)), with a barred L2 seat named beside it. A row owed on the declaration face alone (`TIER_DEFAULT`, new `declarationFaceOnly`) never names an L2 seat, a hand-off to one included. `LANE_JOINS_AFTER_ROUNDS` is removed with the rule it encoded (no importer: `git grep` finds none). Header, `takerOf` docblock and `--help` reworded to match.
4. `SKILL.md` 〈审核两级〉 line 50 reworded (329 → 329 lines): 「L2 档随面定(`contract-review.md`);L1 与 `TIER_DEFAULT` 审核恒归车道,⛔ 永不归 L2 席。」 — the one statement of item 4.

Line budget: every ceiling unchanged and every file at its ceiling (SKILL.md 329/329, contract-review.md 63/63, l2-review.md 22/22); no line added, so nothing is paid and no ceiling moves. Each edited line is at most 120 bytes.

## Tests

`node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test` — 97 cases in 10 batteries (was 91).

Forced test edits (the taker strings changed with the rule):
- Battery 「L2-seat first: …」 (18) is replaced by 「the L2 seat is the fallback: named by a hand-off or on its own delta, never on (b), (c), the label or the TIER_DEFAULT face」 (floor 24). The roster, spelling, claim, own-account, S2/S4 and area-lease cases move with it, their taker assertions rewritten to the lane seat; the 「a further round ⇒ the lane joins」 case is retired with the rule.
- New rows, both ways per branch: the TIER_DEFAULT face with a hand-off to review#1 ⇒ the lane, the same hand-off on the rules face ⇒ review#1; a sibling-lane hand-off on that face still names the sibling; an own-delta record by a seated L2 seat ⇒ that seat, the same row with no earlier record ⇒ the lane; not-own deltas (signer stood down, signed by a lane seat, unsigned, signer barred) ⇒ the lane; a record on this head ⇒ DONE, no taker.
- Battery 「the triggers …」: four taker strings now read `the domain:ui seat (at the tier, or the hand-off line)`.

Ablations (one per new branch; mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob `67bcd12968f2`, `git diff HEAD` empty):

<details><summary>A1 / A2 / A3 at 22915830</summary>

- A1 — TIER_DEFAULT-face branch disabled (`if (false && declarationFaceOnly(limbs))`): 2 of 97 red, both TIER_DEFAULT-face cases.
- A2 — own-delta branch disabled: 1 of 97 red, the own-delta case.
- A3 — the old L2-first answer restored for a seated L2 seat: 8 of 97 red (label, (b), (c), own delta, not-own delta, S2 ×2, printed row).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- SKILL.md line 50 no longer spells the face → tier table; its home is contract-review.md:9–11 (档随面定), unchanged. The statement and the table do not both fit one 120-byte line, and 〈审核两级〉 has no payer line.
- contract-review.md:26 no longer names `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`; the list stays named at contract-review.md:32, lanes/l2-review.md:15, dispatch-runbook.md:44 and triage-duties.md:13.
- A bar the tool cannot see (every other seat able to review the head barred) reaches the L2 seat the one way it reads: a hand-off line naming it. The tool keeps naming an own-account L2 seat as barred beside the lane taker.
- Outside this file surface: `references/dispatch-runbook.md:44` (「每席巡查跑 … TAKE 行剔除本账户署名的 PR」) reads as any seat taking any TAKE row; with the new taker column it would read as taking the rows that name it. Left to the seat; not edited here.
